column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I will give thanks to You” is rendered “I will praise You,” and the jussive “let it turn” as the statement “Your anger is turned away.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Yah Yahweh” is rendered “YAH, the LORD,” and “might” “song.”
Close to the Hebrew; “give thanks” is rendered “Praise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “majesty He has done” is rendered “He has done excellent things.”
